scope: Primary-source research supporting a user-requested revision plan. This is not a new manuscript source ledger or certification of current country rankings, economic outcomes, legal advice, or a v5 empirical application.

sources.title: Building a C compiler with a team of parallel Claudes
sources.locator: Opening; Make parallelism easy; Evaluation; Looking forward
sources.checked: Original full rendered article and indexed primary passages read.
sources.supports: Sixteen-agent compiler experiment; shared failure and redesigned GCC-based checks; capability limitations.
sources.boundary: Attributed vendor/researcher experiment, not independent replication, a commercial replacement estimate, labor-market outcome or causal effect of agent count. Human harness design and external tools count. No repository execution or benchmark replication performed.

sources.title: How we built our multi-agent research system
sources.locator: Benefits; Architecture overview; Effective evaluation; Production reliability
sources.supports: Orchestrator/worker architecture, parallel inquiry, resource costs and coordination limitations.
sources.boundary: Company account and internal evaluations. Architecture is distinct from the later compiler team's explicit absence of an orchestration agent. Extra agent roles do not themselves establish independent economic trials.

sources.title: Scenarios for the Transition to AGI
sources.locator: Abstract; Section 3, Proposition 7, printed pp. 22–23; Section 4.1; specific-capital discussion printed p. 36; conclusion printed p. 37
sources.checked: Original PDF abstract, indexed relevant capital/wage passages and conclusion inspected; not complete 45-page proof review.
sources.supports: Scenario dependence of wages on automation, capital accumulation and task distribution; reproducible capital versus fixed bottlenecks.
sources.boundary: Theoretical scenario model with substantive assumptions, not a forecast or v5 result. Broadly valuable automation and capital formation remain possible; monopoly returns do not follow from reproducible compute alone. Confirm exact final note locators and version during manuscript integration.
